props.title: Tony Medina
props.face: Covers and originals, from one guitar up to a four-piece band.
props.lede: Have you ever stopped mid-conversation because the singer in the corner turned out to be amazing? That’s Tony Medina, who sings The Thrill Is Gone with gravel in his voice and plays guitar with the rhythm of a funk player. He plays the blues and the rock and roll that came out of it, and he can play solo while people talk or bring a four-piece band to get people dancing.
props.headingNote: We’re happy to tailor the music to your event, from the number of musicians to the songs and what they wear. Here’s how booking through Signet works.

rows.text: He’s a great choice for a 50th or a 60th when your guests grew up on these songs. He can keep things quiet over dinner, and the full band can take over when you're ready to dance.

Classic rock goes over well at a company party, since most of your team will know these songs no matter when they grew up. Book the four-piece band if you want a dance floor, at a downtown Denver venue or in your own office.
When the meetings are done, Tony can play the acoustic side of his song list solo or as a duo.
On his own, Tony can play the night before the wedding or the hour after the ceremony, and he’s a great fit if you’d like a little grit in the music.

props.html: If you’re planning speeches or a program, we can work the music around them with your run of show. Want a general idea of what live music costs across Colorado? Take a look at our cost guide.

props.html: Still have a question? Our full question list may have the answer.

items.a: Yes, the trio and the four-piece band can both get people dancing.

When he plays solo, he's on the quiet side. The four-piece band is as loud as you'd expect from a rock band at a good party. He can bring the volume up or down to suit your venue, and if there's a sound limit, just let us know.

items.q: Does he play originals at a private event?
items.a: Only if you want them. He usually sticks to covers at an event, since people tend to dance to songs they recognize. We can work a few of his own songs in if there's time, and it's worth asking about if your guests are there to listen.
